name: Ore Guide
description: Where each metal comes from in this pack, read from the mods' world generation data.

pages.title: Ore Guide
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Zinc**, for brass: Overworld, Y -63 to 70
- **Lead** ore is Create Nuclear's; galena gives a little
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Titanium** and **tungsten** exist only on Northstar's planets
- Ores go further when crushed

Where each metal comes from in this pack, read from the mods' world generation data. Depths are [#](7A3C9A)[Y levels](entry://glossary/y_level)[#](), Overworld unless noted.\
\
Ores go further when [#](2E5AAC)[crushed](entry://materials/ore_doubling)[#](). Unknown block? [#](2E5AAC)[What's This Block?](entry://materials/whats_this_block)[#](). Drillable veins: [#](2E5AAC)[Ore Excavation](entry://industry/ore_excavation)[#]().

pages.title: Vanilla and Create
pages.text:
Coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond and emerald are vanilla. Terrain mods such as Tectonic change where they end up.\
\
**Zinc** comes from Create: Y -63 to 70. [#](2E5AAC)[Brass](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#]() is copper plus zinc.

pages.title: Zinc Ore
pages.text: Overworld, Y -63 to 70, stone and deepslate. Spread evenly: no depth beats another, so look in caves. Northstar's planets have their own zinc ores, and both count as zinc ore in recipes.

pages.title: Create Nuclear
pages.text:
- **Lead**: Y -16 to 60
- **Uranium**: Y -63 to 16, sparse
- **Thorium**: Y -16 to 55
- **Nitrate**: Y -63 to 64, for reactor coolant

[Autunite](item://createnuclear:autunite), a building stone, forms striated veins below Y 16.

pages.title: Lead Ore
pages.text: The only lead ore. Galena also crushes to a little lead. Mining drops [Raw Lead](item://createnuclear:raw_lead). The ore block itself has no crushing recipe; crush the raw lead.

pages.title: Uranium Ore
pages.text: Deep and rare. Feeds [#](2E5AAC)[the reactor](entry://industry/nuclear)[#](). [#](2E5AAC)[Alex's Caves](entry://exploration/alexs_caves)[#]() adds its own uranium in Toxic Caves.

pages.title: TFMG
pages.text:
- **Nickel**: Y -63 to 20
- **Lithium**: Y -63 to -5, sparse
- **Bauxite**: a stone that crushes to powder, the start of aluminum
- **Galena**: crushes to some lead
- Lead: off

Oil: [#](2E5AAC)[Oil](entry://industry/tfmg_oil)[#]().

pages.title: Nickel Ore
pages.text: Y -63 to 20. Nickel goes into TFMG alloys such as constantan. Lithium ore sits deeper, below Y -5.

pages.title: Other Overworld ores
pages.text:
Other mods add Overworld metals:
- **Platinum** (Create Propulsion): Y -63 to about 16
- **Mithril** ([#](2E5AAC)[Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](entry://exploration/irons_spellbooks)[#]()): Y -63 to -38, very deep

pages.title: Platinum Ore
pages.text: Create Propulsion's metal. Crushes and [#](7A3C9A)[washes](entry://glossary/washing)[#]() like any Create ore. Deep Overworld.

pages.title: Mithril Ore
pages.text: Y -63 to -38. Crushing gives [Crushed Mithril](item://create_wizardry:crushed_mithril) from [#](2E5AAC)[Create: Wizardry](entry://exploration/create_wizardry)[#](), which can be washed or smelted.

pages.title: Northstar planets
pages.text:
Titanium and tungsten exist only off-world, in planet-specific blocks.
- **Titanium**: Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus
- **Tungsten**: Mercury only
- Zinc, copper, iron, gold, redstone, diamond: all four

[#](2E5AAC)[Planets](entry://space/planets)[#]()

pages.title: Titanium Ore
pages.text: Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus each have their own block. Drops raw titanium, which smelts to a titanium ingot.

pages.title: More planet ores
pages.text:
- Glowstone: Moon, Mercury, Venus
- Lapis: Moon, Mercury
- Nether quartz: Mars, Venus
- Coal: Venus

Mercury's tungsten ore is plentiful. It crushes to [Crushed Raw Tungsten](item://northstar:crushed_raw_tungsten).

pages.title: Dimension ores
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Ores in other dimensions:
- **Aether**: zanite, gravitite, ambrosium and icestone in holystone
- **Alex's Caves**: galena iron in Magnetic Caves, uranium in Toxic Caves, coal and redstone in Forlorn Hollows
- **Better End**: thallasium, ender and amber ore

pages.title: Zanite Ore
pages.text: [#](2E5AAC)[Aether](entry://exploration/aether)[#]() holystone. Zanite and ambrosium ores have Create crushing recipes, so a [#](2E5AAC)[Crushing Wheel](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]() doubles them too.

pages.title: Not mined
pages.text:
No ore generation of their own:
- Bronze ([#](2E5AAC)[Alloyed](entry://industry/alloyed)[#]()) and steel ([#](2E5AAC)[TFMG](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#]()) are alloys
- Create Crafts & Additions: electrum is an alloy
- Cataclysm: its metals are not mined

[#](2E5AAC)[Twilight Forest](entry://exploration/twilight_forest)[#]() grows Iron, Copper and Gold Oreberry bushes instead of veins.
